meta.title: unslump! - Exercise routine for office workers
meta.description: 25 minutes to counteract hours of computer work and rescue your posture. Routine based on 30+ peer-reviewed scientific studies.

levels.description: Exercises with variations will show instructions adapted to your level.

references.title: Scientific References
references.description: This routine is based on over 30 peer-reviewed studies published between 2015-2025, including systematic reviews, meta-analyses, randomized controlled trials (RCTs), and studies with electromyography (EMG) and ultrasound.
references.accessDescription: Most of these studies are freely available on PubMed Central (PMC), BMC journals, and other open-access databases. Search for PMC codes or DOIs on Google Scholar or PubMed for direct access.

onboarding.subtitle: Your 25-minute science-backed routine to counteract hours of sitting. Based on 30+ peer-reviewed studies.
onboarding.description: Each exercise is backed by scientific research and part of a proven 4-phase system: Inhibit → Lengthen → Activate → Integrate.
onboarding.completeDescription: Click on any exercise card or the ✓ button to mark it as completed. Your progress is saved automatically.
onboarding.infoDescription: Blue buttons with "i" contain detailed information about each exercise: muscles worked, scientific evidence, technical tips, and explanatory YouTube videos.
onboarding.keyTip3: Bird dog: The #1 exercise for core according to studies
onboarding.keyTip4: 12 weeks minimum for lasting structural changes
onboarding.keyTip5: Stop if you experience: Sharp pain, numbness, dizziness
onboarding.reminderText: 💡 Tip: You can view this tutorial anytime by clicking the floating help button.
